26197-the-nursery-rhyme-book.title: The Nursery Rhyme Book
26197-the-nursery-rhyme-book.creator: Unknown
26197-the-nursery-rhyme-book.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. About the people mentioned in this book:--We do not exactly know who Old King Cole was, but King Arthur must have reigned some time about 500 to 600 A.D. As a child grows up, he will, if he is fond of poetry, read thousands of lines about this Prince, and the Table Round where his Knights dined, and how four weeping Queens carried him from his last fight to Avalon, a country where the apple-trees are always in bloom.

6655-tom-slade-boy-scout-of-the-moving-p.title: Boy Scout Of The Moving Pictures
6655-tom-slade-boy-scout-of-the-moving-p.creator: Unknown
6655-tom-slade-boy-scout-of-the-moving-p.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Tom lost no time in offering the opening number of his customary morning program, which was to play some prank on Ching Wo. But Ching Wo, often disturbed, like a true philosopher, and knowing it was Monday, picked out the soiled shirts, piled up the others, threw the muddy stave out and quietly resumed his ironing.

arxiv-1808-08177.title: “Should I Worry?” A Cross-Cultural Examination of Account Security Incident Response
arxiv-1808-08177.creator: Elissa M. Redmiles
arxiv-1808-08177.description: Abstract Digital security technology is able to identify and prevent many threats to users accounts. However, some threats remain that, to provide reliable security, require human intervention: e.g., through users paying attention to warning messages or completing secondary authentication procedures.

arxiv-2103-14456.title: Authorship ethics: an overview of research on the state of practice
arxiv-2103-14456.creator: Nasir Mehmood Minhas
arxiv-2103-14456.description: Abstract Authorship ethics is a central topic of discussion in research ethics fora. There are various guidelines for authorship (i.e., naming and order). It is not easy to decide the authorship in the presence of varying authorship guidelines. This paper gives an overview of research on authorship practices and issues.

arxiv-2111-05208.title: Thermodynamic theory of dislocation/grain boundary interaction Journal: International Journal of Plasticity
arxiv-2111-05208.creator: Y. Piao, K.C. Le
arxiv-2111-05208.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Y. Piao, K.C. Le. The thermodynamic theory of dislocation/grain boundary interaction, including dislocation pile-up against, absorption by, and transfer through the grain boundary, is developed for nonuniform plastic deformations in polycrystals. The case study is carried out on the boundary conditions affecting work hardening of a bicrystal subjected to plane constrained shear for three types of grain boundaries: (i) impermeable hard grain boundary, (ii) grain boundary that allows dislocation transfer without absorption, (iii) grain boundary that absorbs dislocations and allows them to pass later.

arxiv-2210-04803.description: Abstract Although melanoma occurs more rarely than several other skin cancers, patients’ long term survival rate is extremely low if the diagnosis is missed. Diagnosis is complicated by a high discordance rate among pathologists when distinguishing between melanoma and benign melanocytic lesions.

arxiv-2305-02316.creator: T. T. Hansen, J. D. Simon, T. S. Li, A. Frebel, I. Thompson, S. Shectman
arxiv-2305-02316.description: Abstract Context. Carbon Enhanced Metal-Poor (CEMP) stars ( [ C / Fe ] > 0.7 \mathrm{[C/Fe]}>0.7 ) are known to exist in large numbers at low metallicity in the Milky Way halo and are important tracers of early Galactic chemical evolution.

arxiv-2402-18298.title: Mapping between measurement scales in meta-analysis, with application to measures of body mass index in children Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2402-18298.creator: Annabel L Davies, A E Ades, Julian PT Higgins, A. L. Davies, A. E. Ades, J. P. T. Higgins
arxiv-2402-18298.description: Abstract Quantitative evidence synthesis methods aim to combine data from multiple medical trials to infer relative effects of different interventions. A challenge arises when trials report continuous outcomes on different measurement scales. To include all evidence in one coherent analysis, we require methods to ‘map’ the outcomes onto a single scale.

arxiv-2410-04931.title: The Role of Governments in Increasing Interconnected Post-Deployment Monitoring of AI
arxiv-2410-04931.creator: Merlin Stein, Jamie Bernardi, Connor Dunlop
arxiv-2410-04931.description: Abstract Language-based AI systems are diffusing into society, bringing positive and negative impacts. Mitigating negative impacts depends on accurate impact assessments, drawn from an empirical evidence base that makes causal connections between AI usage and impacts. Interconnected post-deployment monitoring combines information about model integration and use, application use, and incidents and impacts.

arxiv-2503-00196.title: PRISM: High-Resolution & Precise Counterfactual Medical Image Generation using Language-guided Stable Diffusion

arxiv-2503-00196.description: Abstract Developing reliable and generalizable deep learning systems for medical imaging faces significant obstacles due to spurious correlations, data imbalances, and limited text annotations in datasets. Addressing these challenges requires architectures robust to the unique complexities posed by medical imaging data.

pmc-10600196.title: Evolutionary game theory and simulations based on doctor and patient medical malpractice under government regulation
pmc-10600196.creator: Lin Song, Zhenlei Yu, Juntao Fang, Qiang He
pmc-10600196.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Physicians-patients are the two crucial participants in medical malpractice. The government, as the central authority responsible for addressing medical malpractices, plays a pivotal role in this matter. Guided by governmental agencies, its regulations, administrative orders, and policies serve as the primary governance mechanisms to address medical malpractice, providing an effective means to balance the doctor-patient relationship and foster social harmony and stable development. A doctor-patient evolutionary game model developed based on the principles of information asymmetry and finite rationality.

pmc-10670340.title: Cellular-Level Analysis of Retinal Blood Vessel Walls Based on Phase Gradient Images
pmc-10670340.creator: Mircea Mujat, Konstantina Sampani, Ankit H Patel, Jennifer K Sun, Nicusor Iftimia, Isabel Pinilla
pmc-10670340.description: Diseases such as diabetes affect the retinal vasculature and the health of the neural retina, leading to vision problems. We describe here an imaging method and analysis procedure that enables characterization of the retinal vessel walls with cellular-level resolution, potentially providing markers for eye diseases.

pmc-11297423.title: Successful management of carinal shift in aortic dissection: A case report of innovative airway management strategies
pmc-11297423.creator: Rahul Kumar Chaudhary, Sajjad Ahmed Khan
pmc-11297423.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Key Clinical MessageThe case underscores the necessity of adaptable airway management strategies in aortic dissection surgeries complicated by carinal shift. Successful lung isolation was achieved using a single‐lumen endotracheal tube after failed attempts with traditional methods and bronchial blockers. INTRODUCTION

Aortic dissection represents a catastrophic medical emergency characterized by the separation of the layers within the aortic wall, leading to the formation of a false lumen. It is associated with high morbidity and mortality rates, demanding prompt diagnosis, and intervention.

pmc-12528203.creator: David Meyer, Lukas Niebel, Christian Seis
pmc-12528203.description: We construct steady non-spherical bubbles and drops, which are traveling wave solutions to the axisymmetric two-phase Euler equations with surface tension, whose inner phase is a bounded connected domain. The solutions have a uniform vorticity distribution in this inner phase and they have a vortex sheet on its surface.

pmc-12729372.description: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), encompassing Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis, represents a chronic inflammatory condition of the gastrointestinal tract characterized by immune dysregulation, oxidative stress, and impaired epithelial barrier function.
